MgmtAppRecording.description:
An App's recording settings, in the answer of `GET`/`POST /mgmt/v1/apps/{app_id}/settings`
(left out while every field has its default).

audio_max_days.description: The App's cap on audio keep days; absent: the org's.

cap_required.description: The App's sessions need `voice:record` to start or stop (default `false`).

required.description: Every call with two or more people is recorded (default `false`).

server_read.description: The App's server may read over mgmt (default `false`).

start_level.description: The lowest level whose members may record (default `none`).

RecordingStartLevel.description:
The lowest level of an App's governed Space whose members may start and stop
recordings. `member` means everyone in the Space. Stored as its wire string.

oneOf.description: Nobody through the App's levels (the default; roles and overwrites still apply).

SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).

display_name.description: The App's display name; absent when unset.

hidden_from_home.description: The App's Spaces are left out of the home client.

max_level.description:
The highest level K2's sync may give in the App's governed Spaces. Old
payloads read as `moderator`.

origin.description: The App's signalling origin; absent when unset.

origins.description:
Flag `app_origins`: the App's further web origins, sorted; absent when none
(old payloads read as none).

recording.description:
Flag `app_recording`: the App's recording settings; absent while every one has its
default (old payloads read as the defaults).

uploads.description:
Whether the App's people may upload files in its governed Spaces. Old payloads
read as `true`.
